nodes.label: checkAlertsDaily N+1 query fix (commit 18706e9)
nodes.rationale: Iterating documents and doing a per-item .get()/query inside a loop caused N+1 reads; fixed by batching (getAll, in-queries, Promise.all over a single aggregated query, or denormalization). Used as the reference pattern for future performance reviews.

nodes.label: Firestore rules IDOR fix (commit 1c24da0)
nodes.rationale: A prior IDOR vulnerability in firestore.rules allowed read/write on a document by ID without validating that request.auth.uid matched the owner or an authorized role; fixed in commit 1c24da0 and used as the pattern to watch for in future rule reviews.

nodes.label: CI test coverage threshold gate (MIN)
nodes.rationale: Task 15 raised the coverage gate from an unreachable MIN=55 (continue-on-error, silently broken due to missing lcov/bc) to a real, enforced MIN=25, reachable given ~2,263 covered lines of ~35,712 production lines at the time. The current ci.yml further lowers it to MIN=8, measured on 2026-07-31 (1213/13988 lines = 8.7%), rounded down so the gate is real today and rises as later tasks add tests.

nodes.label: Finding C-01: usuarios collection readable by any authenticated user (email/name leak)
nodes.rationale: With the least-privileged role token, 30 usuarios documents with correo and nombre_completo were read; caused by firestore.rules:53 allowing any authenticated read. Fixed by restricting to isOwner(userId) || isAdmin() once the talleres projection (Task 7) removed the need for open usuarios reads.

nodes.label: Finding: unlinked mechanic reads/writes any workshop's mantenimientos/historial via bare isMecanico()
nodes.rationale: The same conceptual error (|| isMecanico() without ownership/link check) repeated at six points in firestore.rules and in the talleres update rule, letting any mechanic modify any workshop. A workshop token read 240 mantenimientos and 12 historial_mantenimientos documents belonging to other workshops. Fixed by introducing isVinculadoAlVehiculo which checks vehiculos.talleres_vinculados contains the caller uid.

nodes.label: Finding: IDOR in vehiculos/servicios reads and chat_images storage
nodes.rationale: allow read: if request.auth != null (no ownership check) on /Vehiculos and /Servicios let any authenticated user read any document; storage chat_images allowed any authenticated read/write. Fixed by adding id_propietario/isVehicleOwner checks and, for chat images, verifying Firestore conversation participant membership via firestore.exists/get.
